about: The labelled set of calibrate:clef (04-build-plan 2.16 item 2; 01-core S6, RR7). One triage question per case, in the shape of 01-core 7.3. `label` is the truth by 7.3's criteria: dependent = the patch uses a value, unit, range, name, order or behaviour that held under read_then and no longer holds under is_now; independent = the patch behaves as intended under is_now, or does not depend on this code. Labels are written by hand from those criteria, 02-tidepool 10.3 and the vectors, never from a model's answer. `zone: rule` marks a case the engine decides by a rule row before Clef (kept as a probe). Text references: `seed` = seeds/tidepool, `vector` = the pool of docs/spec/premise-cases.json, `run:<model>:<intent>:<run>` = a module of docs/measurements/models/2026-10-06-engine-<model>.json; `replace` applies [old, new] edits; `entity` takes that entity's source (01-core EN7).

cases.intent: a crab that hides when its energy is low

premise.changed_by_intent: raise the top speed to 3

cases.label: independent
cases.why: The crab never moves (vx 0, vy 0) and its update reads only its energy: no value, unit, range or behaviour of MAX_SPEED is used, so the patch behaves as intended under MAX_SPEED = 3.

cases.intent: move the fish to the right

premise.changed_by_intent: an anemone on the floor

cases.label: independent
cases.why: Moving the fish's start point does not depend on which creatures mention energy; the patch is not a sweep over the matches, so a gained anemone leaves it correct.

cases.intent: an urchin that tires

premise.changed_by_intent: make energy a fraction from 0 to 1

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: The landed urchin starts at energy 100 and tires below 30: both numbers are points of the 0 to 100 scale it read. With ENERGY_MAX = 1 the start value is out of range and the urchin is always tired (02-tidepool HC3 row; the vector's answer is repair).

cases.intent: make energy a fraction from 0 to 1

premise.changed_by_intent: creatures tire twice as fast

cases.label: independent
cases.why: The patch changes only the value of ENERGY_MAX. It does not call drain or rely on its rate; drain still takes an amount in the unit of ENERGY_MAX, so the fraction scale is still what the intent wants.

cases.intent: a creature that rests when its energy is low

premise.changed_by_intent: make energy a fraction from 0 to 1

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: T-energy with the threshold 30, which is 0.3 x the ENERGY_MAX of 100 it read. Under ENERGY_MAX = 1 energy never reaches 30's side of the scale and the creature never moves. In the engine rule E2 decides this (the module names ENERGY_MAX); kept as a probe of Clef's reading.

premise.changed_by_intent: make energy a fraction from 0 to 1

cases.label: independent
cases.why: T-relative states the threshold as ENERGY_MAX * 0.3, which is correct on either scale; the spec names this the designed false abort.

cases.intent: a sea slug that slows down when its energy is below a quarter

premise.changed_by_intent: make energy a fraction from 0 to 1

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: energy: 100 and the bound 25 are points of the 0 to 100 scale that was read. Under ENERGY_MAX = 1 the slug starts far above full and, once drained, is below 25 for good: it no longer slows at a quarter.

cases.intent: a water strider that skates just under the surface

premise.changed_by_intent: lower the water line so there is more sky

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: y = 42 is 'just under the surface' only while SURFACE_Y is 40. With SURFACE_Y = 80 it is in the sky, and the world pulls the strider down each tick.

cases.intent: a water strider that skates just under the surface

premise.changed_by_intent: lower the water line so there is more sky

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: The landed strider hard-codes y = 42 from SURFACE_Y = 40; the asking attempt moves the surface to 80.

cases.intent: a lanternfish that glows at night

premise.changed_by_intent: make the day twice as long

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: The patch computes night as tick % 3600 >= 1800, the day length it read. With DAY_TICKS = 7200 it glows in the middle of the day and is dark for half of the night.

cases.intent: a lanternfish that glows at night

premise.changed_by_intent: make the day twice as long

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: The landed lanternfish copies the old day length (3600 ticks) into its own night test.

cases.intent: a firefly squid that lights up at night

premise.changed_by_intent: make the night shorter: only the last third of the day is dark

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: The squid restates isNight's old rule (phase >= 0.5) instead of calling it. After R09 night starts at 2/3 of the day, so the squid lights up during the evening while the pool is still day.

cases.intent: a sailfish that always swims at the top speed

premise.changed_by_intent: let creatures swim half as fast again at top speed

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: The speed 3 is the top speed it read. With MAX_SPEED = 4.5 the sailfish swims at two thirds of the top speed, not at it.

cases.intent: a sailfish that always swims at the top speed

premise.changed_by_intent: let creatures swim half as fast again at top speed

cases.why: The landed sailfish hard-codes 3 as 'the top speed'; the asking attempt raises MAX_SPEED to 4.5.

cases.intent: a diving bird that dives once each time a pellet drops

premise.changed_by_intent: drop food twice as often

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: The dive every 30 ticks copies FOOD_EVERY = 30. With food every 15 ticks it dives at every second pellet.

cases.intent: a diving bird that dives once each time a pellet drops

premise.changed_by_intent: drop food twice as often

cases.intent: a clam that shows a bar counting down its rest

premise.changed_by_intent: tired creatures should rest for half as long

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: The bar's length divides by 300, the rest length read from REST_TICKS. With REST_TICKS = 150 the bar starts half full instead of full.

cases.intent: a grouper that stops hunting after it has eaten four pellets

premise.changed_by_intent: one pellet of food should fill half a creature's energy

cases.label: dependent
cases.why: 4 * 25 counts four pellets of FOOD_ENERGY = ENERGY_MAX / 4. With a pellet worth half the energy the grouper stops after two pellets.
